decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans J/352/01, J/352/02 received 7th May 2010 and J/352/10 and Design and Access statement received 13th September 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted for MOT testing area shall not be carried on outside the following times 9am to 19.00 Mondays to Fridays and 09.00 to 18.00 on Saturdays

Condition : 4 - The whole of the building shall only be occupied by one operator and only the MOT use be carried out in the part of the building that is outlined in red on the approved drawing J/352/10.
description: Use of part of building as MOT testing area.
